body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Panasonic(www.panasonic.com) unveiled its first Tablet PC 'VIERA' for the first time at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
It is said that VIERA Tablet will offer Crowd Service connected to TV with Android as basic platform and Panasonic will make diverse sizes of it.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
